name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your films, series and music to every device, from a media folder of your pool.

settings.label: Media folder
settings.hint: The NAS's media share: put your films and music there over SMB (\\<NAS>\media). Made now if it is missing and kept if Jellyfin goes; Jellyfin only reads it.

settings.label: Run as
settings.hint: The account Jellyfin's files belong to; it needs to read the media folder.
